scope: method formulation, factual supervision and decision-identifiability; not another baseline run
training_trigger: Only if a substantively distinct learning estimator has identifiable labels and a non-equivalent same-information planning decision; otherwise zero training

corpus.mimicgen_probe_role: excluded from primary corpus; known repair and repeated replay dependence

anchor: first measured bilateral target-object contact state, if present; no height/lift proxy defines capability
effects: recorded object displacement and official placement/retreat predicate word; no invented task predicate
factual_outcome: official full-task success under the recorded continuation/controller and recorded stopping rule
capacity_negative: requires a genuine impossibility certificate; never inferred from a failed rollout
cross_embodiment_pairing: all 80 original task/index UR5e-Panda Joint pairs, descriptive only; different histories are not causal pairs
matched_state_checks: all five actual mechanism handoff groups, all three recorded continuations; no new forks or restores
planning_check: candidate evidence-backed predecessor operator versus independent exhaustive witnessed-path search on identical graph and budgets; this is not a full continuous TAMP implementation
offline_gt_role: label feasibility and oracle information-tier analysis only; not deployed policy input
test_exposure: existing 60-99 exposed; no independent unseen test or new physical success rate
